acceptance_criteria.theme: `pi_curator.py` CuratorService：读取 boundary approved 池；`tick` 对无提案空跑 pass；构建 curation request（proposal_id/topic/anchors/prompt）
knowledge_scan 扫描 knowledge_root（ideas/daily/bases）按 topic token 命中文件生成 anchors；agentmemory 不可用时降级文件检索不抛错
选题卡 schema（curator-card.v1）校验：topic/sources/knowledge_refs/market_signals/status 必填且引用 anchors；缺锚点 fail-closed
写回 personal-brain：`<knowledge_root>/ideas/<slug>-<date>.md` + YAML frontmatter + dispatch_id 绑定；越界写 fail-closed
CLI：`adb curator list --status approved` / `request --proposal <id>` / `apply --proposal <id> --response-json <file>` / `tick --project <slug> --limit N`；curator_cards ledger 落账

pi-beacon 扩展包：`skills/pi-beacon/extension.ts`（registerTool adb_dispatch + registerCommand /prism + session_start 知识提示）+ `install.sh`（幂等合并 settings.skills、拷贝扩展，支持 --dry-run）；driver_pi create_task 追加有界任务正文（Bounded task 段）
定时整合：复用 ScheduleService should_run/quota 与 boundary cron 形态；curator 不自动审批/apply；hermes 兼容回归（既有 157 测试全绿）

test_rows.command: `python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_pi_curator.py -k 'approved_pool or empty_tick or request' --tb=short`
test_rows.assertion: exit_code_0；approved 读取；空池 tick pass；request 含 anchors
exit_code_0；文件锚点命中；agentmemory 不可用降级
exit_code_0；extension.ts 注册 adb_dispatch/prism；install.sh --dry-run 幂等；bounded body 追加
